verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana Serai, aye rẹ Ebram na, ji vwiẹ ọmọ kẹ-ẹ. Yo vwo ọmọtẹ rẹ Ijipt ọvo ro gbe odibo kẹ rẹ odẹ rọye Hagar;
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana serai aye re ebram na ji vwie omo ke e yo vwo omote re ijipt ovo ro gbe odibo ke re ode roye hagar

verses.text_urhobo: Serai da ta kẹ Ebram, Gbe no, Ọrovwohwo kanro ovwẹ o gbi ju vwe vwiẹ ọmọ-ọ, gbe bru ọmọtẹ mẹ na ra, ọkeọvo ke Me wan oma rọye vwo ọmọ. Ebram de nyo ota ri Serai na.
verses.text_romanized: serai da ta ke ebram gbe no orovwohwo kanro ovwe o gbi ju vwe vwie omo o gbe bru omote me na ra okeovo ke me wan oma roye vwo omo ebram de nyo ota ri serai na

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye, Ebram rhe vwọ dia Kenan ikpe ihwe nure, Serai, aye rẹ Ebram na, da vwi Hagar ohwo rẹ Ijipt ọmọtẹ rọye, vwọ kẹ Ebram ọshare rọye vwọ rọvwọ.
verses.text_romanized: koye ebram rhe vwo dia kenan ikpe ihwe nure serai aye re ebram na da vwi hagar ohwo re ijipt omote roye vwo ke ebram oshare roye vwo rovwo

verses.text_urhobo: O de bru Hagar ra, ọ da mrevun, rọ vwọ mrevun nure na, ko nẹ onini rọye na Serai saka.
verses.text_romanized: o de bru hagar ra o da mrevun ro vwo mrevun nure na ko ne onini roye na serai saka

verses.text_urhobo: Serai da ta kẹ Ebram, Jẹn oruchọ ri mi ruru dia uyovwi wẹn; Me da vwẹ ọmọtẹ mẹ vwọ kẹ wẹ vwọ rọvwọ, rọ rhe vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọye mrevun na, ko ni vwe saka. Gbe jẹ Ọrovwohwo brorhiẹ mẹ vẹ ọwẹn,
verses.text_romanized: serai da ta ke ebram jen orucho ri mi ruru dia uyovwi wen me da vwe omote me vwo ke we vwo rovwo ro rhe vwo mre ne oye mrevun na ko ni vwe saka gbe je orovwohwo brorhie me ve owen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ebram da ta kẹ Serai, Nighe, ogangan rẹ ọmọtẹ wẹn o rhe we, vwo ru obo ri je we. Etiyin Serai da djoma kpahọ, ọ da djẹ nẹ obọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ebram da ta ke serai nighe ogangan re omote wen o rhe we vwo ru obo ri je we etiyin serai da djoma kpaho o da dje ne obo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo da mrẹ vwẹ asan ogbugbu rẹ ame vwẹ evun rẹ aghwa, ogbugbu rọ orhoma rẹ idjerhe re de kpo Shur na.
verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo da mre vwe asan ogbugbu re ame vwe evun re aghwa ogbugbu ro orhoma re idjerhe re de kpo shur na

verses.text_urhobo: O da tanẹ, Hagar, ọmọtẹ ri Serai, tivọ wo nurhe ki tivọ wọ je ra? Ọ da tanẹ, Me djẹ nẹ obọ rẹ onini mẹ Serai
verses.text_romanized: o da tane hagar omote ri serai tivo wo nurhe ki tivo wo je ra o da tane me dje ne obo re onini me serai

verses.text_urhobo: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da ta kẹ, Rhivwi bru onini wẹn, ru wọ vwẹ oma kpotọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da ta ke rhivwi bru onini wen ru wo vwe oma kpoto ke

verses.text_urhobo: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da je ta kẹ, Mi che ru uvwiẹ wẹn buebu gangan re de je se kere.
verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da je ta ke mi che ru uvwie wen buebu gangan re de je se kere

verses.text_urhobo: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da ta kẹ, Nighere, wọ mrevun, ku wo vwiẹ ọmọshare, gbe se odẹ rọye Ishmael, fikiridie Ọrovwohwo nyo oja wẹn re.
verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da ta ke nighere wo mrevun ku wo vwie omoshare gbe se ode roye ishmael fikiridie orovwohwo nyo oja wen re

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ cha họhọ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rọ djoma, rẹ obọ rọye mu kohwo kohwo rẹ obọ ri kohwo kohwo ji mu rhe, vwẹ irharo rẹ imoni rọye o de yenre akpọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: o cha hoho eketekete ro djoma re obo roye mu kohwo kohwo re obo ri kohwo kohwo ji mu rhe vwe irharo re imoni roye o de yenre akpo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye o de se asan rẹ Ọrovwohwo da ta ota kẹ na, Wẹ Ọghẹnẹ rọ mrorẹ, kidie ọ tare nẹ, Ke Me ghene mrẹ Ọghẹnẹ, Me mrẹrẹ nu Me da je rhọ?
verses.text_romanized: koye o de se asan re orovwohwo da ta ota ke na we oghene ro mrore kidie o tare ne ke me ghene mre oghene me mrere nu me da je rho

verses.text_urhobo: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se orhare na Beer-lahai-roi, ọ ughwru ri Kadẹsh vi Bẹrẹd.
verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na e de se orhare na beer lahai roi o ughwru ri kadesh vi bered

verses.text_urhobo: Hagar de vwiẹ ọmọshare kẹ Ebram, Ebram de se odẹ rẹ ọmọ na ri Hagar vwiẹ kẹ na Ishmael.
verses.text_romanized: hagar de vwie omoshare ke ebram ebram de se ode re omo na ri hagar vwie ke na ishmael

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da dia ikpe ujọne gbẹ esan vwẹ ọke ri Hagar vwo vwiẹ Ishmael kẹ Ebram.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da dia ikpe ujone gbe esan vwe oke ri hagar vwo vwie ishmael ke ebram
